_written: AFTER THE FACT, 2026-11-13 1:00 PM Pacific: P4's machines changed three times (GitHub queue, Google, GitHub) and P1-P3 were sealed on a PBAT set; this sheet records the corrected design for P4 and P5

physics.where_iam_law: the thermal part of the loss (CANON eps0_candidate: two coins per restore against thermal kicks at 310 K) is the same in every cell type; removing the eraser should leave each type near it, so the types converge

data.set: P4 GSE161463 (mature splenic B, TET2+TET3 removed, 2 WT + 2 KO); P5 GSE66834 (iNKT, same laboratory, 2 WT + 2 KO young)
data.protocol_read: GSE161463: 1 ug DNA, lambda spike, sonicated, end repaired, A-tailed, methylated adaptors, Methylcode bisulfite. GSE66834: Covaris 200 bp, lambda spike 1:200, end repair, MethylC-seq, paired 2x100
data.spent_first: no: no spent set has the eraser removed in mature blood cell types; PHY-085's two progenitor types sit 1.2 % apart, too close to answer
data.alternatives: GSE210026 (PBAT, about 500 cells, ends clipped: withdrawn); PRJNA1403508 (TET1/2/3 in five lineages: not public); Lio 2016 pro-B (to check)
data.needs: standard directional libraries, paired reads, whole-genome spread, genotype labels, lambda spike for conversion

preflight.checked: AFTER THE FACT: the GSE161463 canary (2 million pairs): pairing, mapped share, quality-failed share
preflight.result: paired, 99.8 % mapped, 2.8 % quality-failed; chromosome spread passed the chain's coverage check

kiss.smallest: two wild type and two knockout per type: the fewest that measure replicate scatter
kiss.samples_why: each arm needs two to measure its own scatter (the not-assessed rule)

save.resume: ckpt: a failed run reruns from its saved molecules (erase_test.yml patfrom=<run id>), no realignment

watchers.stop_condition: all P4 and P5 runs completed (p4_runs.txt, p5_runs.txt)

cosmologist.method: forward model through the same counter (the PHY-085 grid); each library self-calibrated on its lambda spike-in conversion
cosmologist.null_test: the two wild-type replicates per type must agree within half the expected effect before any ratio is read

value.question: does removing TET2 and TET3 bring each mature blood type to one thermal level? (A8, the top item after PHY-084)

options.name: cosmologist's way: canary depth (2 million pairs) per library, ratio through the forward model
options.why: 2 million pairs gives about 1.5 % counting error per library, as large as the replicate scatter
